sql: SELECT 'model_score' source,COUNT(*) rows,COUNT(DISTINCT name||':'||version||':'||step) steps,COUNT(DISTINCT name||':'||version) models FROM model_score UNION ALL SELECT 'model',COUNT(*),COUNT(DISTINCT name||':'||version||':'||step),COUNT(DISTINCT name||':'||version) FROM model;
SELECT m.name,m.version,m.L1_model,COUNT(DISTINCT m.step) steps FROM model m GROUP BY m.name,m.version,m.L1_model HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.step)>1 ORDER BY steps DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT name,version,step,model,COUNT(*) n,MIN(test_score) lo,MAX(test_score) hi FROM model_score GROUP BY name,version,step,model HAVING COUNT(*)>1 LIMIT 20

WITH scores AS (SELECT name,version,step,MAX(CASE WHEN model<>'Stack' THEN test_score END) baseline,MAX(CASE WHEN model='Stack' THEN test_score END) stack_score FROM model_score GROUP BY name,version,step), step_status AS (SELECT name,version,step,CASE WHEN baseline<stack_score THEN 'strong' WHEN baseline=stack_score THEN 'soft' END status FROM scores), units AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.name,m.version,m.L1_model,s.status FROM model m JOIN step_status s ON s.name=m.name AND s.version=m.version AND s.step=m.step WHERE s.status IS NOT NULL AND m.L1_model IS NOT NULL), counts AS (SELECT L1_model,status,COUNT(*) occurrences FROM units GROUP BY L1_model,status) SELECT status,L1_model,occurrences FROM counts c WHERE occurrences=(SELECT MAX(occurrences) FROM counts x WHERE x.status=c.status) ORDER BY status,L1_model

WITH b AS (SELECT name,version,MAX(test_score) baseline FROM model_score WHERE model<>'Stack' GROUP BY name,version), st AS (SELECT s.name,s.version,s.step,CASE WHEN b.baseline<s.test_score THEN 'strong' WHEN b.baseline=s.test_score THEN 'soft' END status FROM model_score s JOIN b USING(name,version) WHERE s.model='Stack') SELECT m.L1_model,st.status,COUNT(*) step_count,COUNT(DISTINCT m.name||':'||m.version) model_count FROM model m JOIN st USING(name,version,step) WHERE status IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.L1_model,status ORDER BY status,m.L1_model
SELECT name,type,sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE name IN ('stack_ok','solution_ext','stack_ok_score');

CREATE VIEW stack_ok AS select A.name, A.version, A.step, C.L1_model, 'strong' as status
        from (select name, version, step, max(test_score) as max_test_score 
              from model_score where model not in ('Stack') 
              group by name, version, step) as A
        inner join 
             (select name, version, step, test_score as stack_score 
              from model_score 
              where model = 'Stack') as B
        on A.name = B.name
        and A.version = B.version
        and A.step = B.step
        inner join 
            model as C
            on A.name = C.name
            and A.version = C.version
        where A.max_test_score < B.stack_score
        group by A.name, A.version, A.step
union all
select A.name, A.version, A.step, C.L1_model, 'soft' as status
        from (select name, version, step, max(test_score) as max_test_score 
              from model_score where model not in ('Stack') 
              group by name, version, step) as A
        inner join 
             (select name, version, step, test_score as stack_score 
              from model_score 
              where model = 'Stack') as B
        on A.name = B.name
        and A.version = B.version
        and A.step = B.step
        inner join 
            model as C
            on A.name = C.name
            and A.version = C.version
        where A.max_test_score = B.stack_score
        group by A.name, A.version, A.step
order by A.name, A.version

CREATE VIEW solution_ext AS select name, version, L1_model
from model
group by name, version, L1_model
order by name

CREATE VIEW stack_ok_score AS select distinct test_score_1.name, test_score_1.version, test_score_1.score_1, test_score_2.score_2, test_score_3.score_3
from
(select A.name, A.version, A.test_score as score_1
 from model_score as A
 inner join stack_ok as B
 on A.name = B.name
 and A.version = B.version
 where A.model = 'Stack'
 and A.step = 1) as test_score_1
inner join
(select A.name, A.version, A.test_score as score_2
 from model_score as A
 inner join stack_ok as B
 on A.name = B.name
 and A.version = B.version
 where A.model = 'Stack'
 and A.step = 2) as test_score_2
 on test_score_1.name = test_score_2.name
 and test_score_1.version = test_score_2.version
inner join
(select A.name, A.version, A.test_score as score_3
 from model_score as A
 inner join stack_ok as B
 on A.name = B.name
 and A.version = B.version
 where A.model = 'Stack'
 and A.step = 3) as test_score_3
 on test_score_1.name = test_score_3.name
 and test_score_1.version = test_score_3.version
